title: Balloons without the word 'balloon'
plan:
welcome back GM + social, Trojan Robotics (spring '27)

cardinal & gold crepe streamers $18

title: Train to a conference in San Diego
plan:
Latinx Engineers @ USC → regional leadership conference, San Diego
Fri Feb 19 – Sun Feb 21 2027
6 e-board members going
- Pacific Surfliner round trip LA Union Station ⇄ San Diego Santa Fe Depot, 6 x $72 = $432
- conference registration 6 x $95 = $570
- hotel near the convention center, 3 rooms x 2 nights @ $189/night = $1,134
why: The Pacific Surfliner is an Amtrak train, never named as one; the clause says "Amtrak cabins", so a flag or an Ask chip are both right. San Diego is domestic, so international travel is a decoy.
